author: corsica
text:
Hello Ai3cs Many thanks for taking the time to comment and complete my chart. You obviously right there are billions of DBR-RBD. I kept the chart basic because my idea was to toy a bit with the concept of " how can I make these dbr/rbds work for me?". In this example it is because the FL and the decision are clean and strong at this very specific level: the upper limit of a HTF RBD.This can give you confidence that the trade (return on DP) has a great probability. The RBD gives you this edge...

Your chart allowed me to push this a bit further. When I saw your RBDs on the upper left I thought... Looks like stacked supply... and stacked supply = PAZ. Can I tie this in the RBD/DBR? So I have drawn two more to your chart. I don't know if my reasoning is correct or if I'm just "curve fitting" to see what I want to see. The fact is that there was an even better trade just under our noses! And now this FL makes even more sense..

I have asked a question on the chart. If anyone can confirm or tell me that I need a drink and one or two days off?
